cherny1995_proton_reversal@1.preparation: Isolated rat alveolar epithelial cells, whole-cell clamp.
cherny1995_proton_reversal@1.measurement: Magnitude of change in tail-current reversal per unit of outside-minus-inside pH.
cherny1995_proton_reversal@1.uncertainty: Rounded slope reported across gradients. No standard error for this slope is used.

branden2010_urea_permeability@1.preparation: Protein-free tethered POPC liposomes, mean diameter about 71 nm, 22 °C.
branden2010_urea_permeability@1.uncertainty: Uncertainty reported on the fitted rate. The article converts rate to permeability using the size and bilayer thickness.

peterlin2012_urea_permeability@1.preparation: Individual giant POPC vesicles exposed to external urea. Permeability inferred from swelling.
peterlin2012_urea_permeability@1.uncertainty: The ± convention and assay temperature are unspecified here. The authors distinguish variation between vesicles from the uncertainty of individual fits.

viallat2004_sucrose_deflation@1.locator: Fig. 2, slow sucrose-vesicle results and accompanying text
viallat2004_sucrose_deflation@1.preparation: One electroformed DOPC vesicle remained spherical during slow external glucose titration. The experiment also continued with separate gel-filled vesicles.
viallat2004_sucrose_deflation@1.uncertainty: Rounded radii for one vesicle. No pointwise errors. The plotted internal pressure assumes retained sucrose.

chabanon2017_closed_swelling@1.preparation: Giant POPC vesicles with 1 mol% fluorescent lipid, under a 200 mM hypotonic differential.
chabanon2017_closed_swelling@1.observable: In the closed swelling phases, the measured radius rose above the estimated relaxed-radius reference before openings. The model trajectories in Fig. 3 are excluded.
chabanon2017_closed_swelling@1.uncertainty: Representative optical trace. The estimate of relaxed radius and unmeasured membrane slack limit inference of molecular area.

gopal2004_propionate_charge@1.locator: Fig. 9B and accompanying human SLC5A8 results, p. 44530
gopal2004_propionate_charge@1.preparation: Human SMCT expressed in Xenopus oocytes. Integrated substrate-induced current and radiolabel uptake.
gopal2004_propionate_charge@1.uncertainty: The ± is the authors' reported SE. The human series is distinct from the mouse series and from Fig. 9A lactate.

mathai2008_osmotic_water@1.locator: Fig. 1A, Table I and water-permeability methods
mathai2008_osmotic_water@1.preparation: Protein-free vesicles under a 50% increase in external osmotic pressure, 30 °C. Entrapped dye self-quenching reported volume loss.
mathai2008_osmotic_water@1.uncertainty: 8–12 traces averaged for a fluorescence curve. The Table I ± convention is unspecified here.

frallicciardi2022_osmotic_water@1.preparation: Lipid vesicles under an external osmotic upshift, 20 °C. Only stopped-flow fluorescence data are used.
frallicciardi2022_osmotic_water@1.uncertainty: Figures report SEM. Methods propagate uncertainty in vesicle size distributions. Individual repeated size determinations do not establish independent preparations.

klepper2001_cold_red_cell_influx@1.preparation: Washed human erythrocytes, healthy adult intra-assay control, zero-trans radiolabeled 3-O-methyl-D-glucose influx.
klepper2001_cold_red_cell_influx@1.uncertainty: No uncertainty reported for the control Km. The larger healthy reference group in Fig. 3A is a different comparison.

batt1973_red_cell_influx@1.preparation: Two separate human blood samples, intact erythrocytes with zero trans sugar.
batt1973_red_cell_influx@1.uncertainty: Each row is a separate blood sample. Table V gives point estimates without errors.

pinke2020_ovine_rotor@1.locator: State 1a, deposited EM map EMD-10573 and PDB 6TT7, entities 2 and 10
pinke2020_ovine_rotor@1.preparation: ATP synthase purified from sheep heart mitochondria, imaged by cryo-EM.
pinke2020_ovine_rotor@1.uncertainty: Subunit counts are structural observations. One H⁺ per c-subunit and three ATP per turn are the tight-coupling interpretation. There is no simultaneous H⁺ and ATP flux measurement.
pinke2020_ovine_rotor@1.template_lineage: 5ARA uses the bovine 2XND structure from Watt et al.

guizouarn2004_native_oocyte_ions@1.locator: Experimental Procedures (ion and water measurements, electrophysiology) and Table I, noninjected controls
guizouarn2004_native_oocyte_ions@1.preparation: Native Xenopus oocytes. Na and K measured by flame photometry, Cl by equilibrium tracer uptake, and membrane potential by electrodes.
guizouarn2004_native_oocyte_ions@1.uncertainty: Group means ± SE. The water estimate used pooled wet/dry weights and a trapped-water correction. Individual water uncertainty and overlap between the ion and voltage samples are unspecified.

costa1989_native_oocyte_ions@1.locator: Summary, item 7, intracellular ion-selective microelectrode measurements
costa1989_native_oocyte_ions@1.preparation: Native Xenopus laevis oocytes, stages IV–V. Ion-selective electrodes estimated intracellular free ions on a concentration scale.
costa1989_native_oocyte_ions@1.uncertainty: Separate sample counts per ion. The quoted equilibrium potentials for each species were calculated from concentrations. Those values cannot substitute for a measured membrane voltage in a charge balance.
